summary.name: Wordvice AI
summary.one_liner: Wordvice AI is a web-based AI writing assistant offering proofreading, paraphrasing, translation, summarizing, plagiarism checking and AI-content detection tools.
keywords: check if text is ai generated
summary.what_it_does: Wordvice AI provides a set of AI writing tools: an AI proofreader for grammar, style and vocabulary feedback, an AI paraphraser with multiple modes, a translator, a summarizer, a plagiarism checker, and an AI detector. The page says the free tier includes Basic tools with 5,000 words per month, while Premium tools are listed at a starting price of $9.95 per month with 1,000,000 words per month. A Team plan starts at $8.45 per month and gives one account unlimited team members. The page also offers optional English editing by human native-speaking editors with PhD or Master's degrees.
notable: Paraphraser with multiple modes to control output
Optional human English editing by PhD and Master's-level native editors
Team plan with unlimited team members on one account
caveats: Free Basic plan is capped at 5,000 words per month and offers only basic tools and revision modes
Premium and Team plans are paid, and Premium tools are needed for full access
Human expert proofreading is a separate on-demand service
